_note: Hand-written expected citation sets for the T4.3 curator measurement, against patients-v1.yaml. 'expected' is the minimal set (the operation plus the most specific element the claim names); 'also_accepted' are related elements that genuinely support the claim (ancestors, arguments, types named by the claim) and count as true positives. 'rests_on_nothing' cases expect an empty citation. IDs are Vimanam ve2_ values from testdata/vimanam/README.md.

M1.memory: GET /patients returns every patient in one response; one call exports the whole clinic

M2.memory: GET /patients/{id} returns 404 for an unknown patient id

M3.memory: GET /stats patient_count is the total number of patients

M4.memory: POST /admin/decommission is permanent once confirmed; there is no undo

X1.memory: A GET to /patients/{id} with an id that does not exist comes back 404 (endpoint named by path)

X2.memory: listPatients gives back the full patient list in a single call (endpoint named by operation ID)

X3.memory: One export call fetches the entire clinic; there is no paging to handle (behaviour only, no names)

X4.memory: The monthly patient-count report runs at 02:00 on the first of the month (outside the contract)

X5.memory: patient_count on the stats endpoint tells you how many patients there are in total (M3 paraphrase)

X6.memory: Decommissioning takes a confirmation token and cannot be reversed (M4 variant)

X7.memory: Every patient record carries its vaccination history and allergy notes (type fields)

X8.memory: Lambo marks a contradicted memory with a warning when it is recalled (about the memory system, not the contract)

X9.memory: Looking up a single patient by id returns that patient's record (behaviour only, success path)

X10.memory: The stats endpoint reports when the counts were generated (generated_at exists only in v2, not in v1)

X11.memory: POST /patients creates a new patient and returns its id (no such endpoint in the contract)

X12.memory: The list endpoint accepts a cursor to page through patients (cursor exists only in v2, not in v1)
